links.outcome: GPT-4 coronary artery disease risk assessment across identical vignettes varying gender and psychiatric comorbidity
links.effect: Psychiatric comorbidity may influence GPT-4's coronary artery disease risk assessment among men and women; the abstract gives no numbers.
links.quote: Results suggest that psychiatric conditions may influence GPT-4's coronary artery disease risk assessment among men and women.

screen.reason: Empirical study testing gender bias and psychiatric comorbidity bias in GPT-4 using clinical vignettes for cardiovascular risk assessment.
